title: The Ashbee Hall
intro: A bright, versatile event space at Toynbee Hall for workshops, receptions, private dinners and community events.

blocks.heading: A flexible historic venue
paragraphs: Ashbee Hall combines the character of Toynbee Hall’s Victorian building with contemporary facilities. Layouts and event support can be tailored to suit your plans.

blocks.heading: Plan your event
paragraphs: Catering and event production can be arranged. Call 020 7392 2920 or email events@toynbeehall.org.uk to discuss your requirements.
